Both panes type shell commands into HeapVM. The synthesizer stays in the engine.

Encryptid MicroVM

A hypervisor in WASM. WSL boots a distro on it: the kernel at C:\WSL\kernel, an ext2 root on a virtio-scsi disk, and init at /sbin/wsl-init. The guest treats that machine as its hypervisor and reads the CPUID it answers. These buttons send hv, wsl --status, wsl -l, and wsl-alpine. Boot Alpine takes the console; the guest stays there until it stops.

iEDA

Electronic design automation for a Harvard MAC. The instruction side is the spatial netlist and the Jev microcode ROM, with no program counter. The data side is separate: streams, weight registers, SRAM, Wishbone, and SPI. The word path is a multiply-accumulate of 32-bit processing elements beside LUT4 control. Emit, check, and import go through gpu fabric eda. Files are written to C:\eda. The console reply stops at 16 KB; download C:\eda saves the rest as eda.zip.
